notes._about: Shared lyrics cases (spec/lyrics/lyrics.md). Every port reads this file. Times in ms. A line is {start, end}; agent ids as in TTML.
notes.currentLine: lyrics.md §2.4. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:111-121 (findCurrentLineIndex): line i is current while the next line's start is at or after position + 100; -1 before the first. Input: line starts and the position.
notes.offset: lyrics.md §3. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:94-107: offset = song + global; lyrics position = player position + offset; a seek by lyrics goes to max(0, lyric time - offset).
notes.sides: lyrics.md §5.2. Metrolist LyricsUtils.kt:160-235 (assignLineAlignments). agents: optional {id: 'person' | 'group' | 'other'}; a line's agent may be null. respect: the sides setting. Expect left, right or center per line.
notes.gaps: lyrics.md §6.1. Metrolist LyricsListIndexing.kt:28-53. Expect [start, end] per gap, in order.

currentLine.name: 100 ms before the second line: still the first
99 ms before the second line: the second

offset.name: a positive offset shows lyrics earlier
a seek by lyrics never goes below 0

sides.name: two singers alternate, a group is centred
the first singer 'other' starts on the right
85% or more on the right: all swapped
types from the agent list win over the id
sides off: centre, a group too

gaps.name: an intro and a gap between lines
a first line at 6999: no intro; exactly 7000 between lines is a gap
the latest end counts, not the last line's
